performance_intent: Moves JavaScript-format parsing out of the common float conversion path
checked_scope: Public from_chars_advanced<double,char> for text .5 with chars_format::json | chars_format::javascript; source-audited selected parser branches for valid/error/consumed
checker: Exact historical native binaries with ASan/UBSan; bidirectional Alive2 on the exact parser specializations selected by the historical dispatchers

result.controls: Named JavaScript format accepts .5 on both sides; named JSON format rejects .5 on both sides
result.sanitizers: ASan/UBSan reruns of both historical public binaries reproduce results without diagnostics

limitations: Witness uses a bitwise combination of two named modes, not either named mode alone. Alive2 checks a source-audited parser-dispatch slice rather than the full public floating-point call chain. No official local before/after benchmark score measured.
